text:
Type: grey wall shelf with hooks
Use: displaying dishes, mugs and decor, hanging towels or utensils; kitchen, dining room, hallway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, classic
Materials: grey painted wood finish, curved solid brackets, small metal hooks
Colors: soft mid grey, silver
Shape: long flat shelf over a narrow front rail with a row of small hooks beneath, two curved scroll-shaped brackets, overhanging ends, medium visual weight
Feel: homely, orderly, cottage-like
Goes with: white tiles or walls, butcher-block wood, white ceramics; farmhouse kitchens, country dining rooms
